hook.line: What kind of job makes $3 million a year?
hook.visual: Top: streamer in headphones; bottom: photo of a suited finance executive on a trading floor; the question in a white box with money emojis on the seam.

beats.what: Streamer asks the question; the title box on the seam repeats it with '$3 million EVERY year'.
He says he is curious; the answer is set up with the trading-floor photo below.
Answer starts: mid-level employees at a trading firm make five to ten million; chat overlay reads 'HE feels POOR'.
He throws his head back at the hedge-fund numbers.
Measured motion: he leans back in, as the answer escalates to five to twenty million for a hedge-fund PM.
Jaw-drop face on 'tens of millions' for a good VC, held to the end.

why_it_works: A money question with a specific number ($3 million) opens a curiosity gap that the answer keeps escalating past.
The bottom-half photo of a finance executive on a trading floor tells the viewer the topic before the answer arrives.
The streamer's open-mouth reaction is the payoff; viewers watch for the face, and the clip loops cleanly (loop score 0.978).
weaknesses: No cuts at all in 25 s (0 cuts); the only movement is his head.
Very quiet audio (-28.1 LUFS) and no word captions, so the numbers are lost with the sound off.
The bottom half is one still photo for the whole video; it never changes with the numbers.
for_robert: Steal the escalating-number answer with a reaction: have Fred's eyes widen or jaw drop each time the number goes up, rather than a static image filling half the frame.
